subject: Follow-up: security discovery recap — SOC 2 Type II & trust portal / DSQ kickoff
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Diane Holt <diane.holt@ornaxhealth.com>
Cc: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-10T14:05:00-08:00
Subject: Quick recap + next steps (security discovery)

Hi Diane — thanks again for the demo earlier today. Appreciate you walking us through the primary security and procurement checkpoints for Ornax. Quick recap and proposed next steps from our side: 

- Redwood status: SOC 2 Type II in scope (audit completed Aug 2026), multi-region data controls, GDPR DPA in place.
- Items you requested: SOC 2 Type II report (we can provide limited redacted copy), bridge letter/interim attestation, and access to our trust portal to review artifacts.
- Procurement timeline you mentioned: vendor evaluation complete by 11/24 — if we can get the bridge letter + portal access this week it will help speed things.

Next actions: 
1) Mina (cc) will coordinate the portal invite + share a temporary bridge letter and steps for the vendor security questionnaire (DSQ).
2) Diane, if you can confirm the preferred contact for legal/procurement and any compliance mailbox (procurement@?) we will route artifacts there.
3) Jordan will be available for a 30m technical follow-up if the security team wants deeper controls discussion (SLA, encryption, key management).

Thanks — I’ll leave the coordination to Mina to keep this moving.

Best,
Ben
Ben Carter
Enterprise Sales | Redwood Inference
attachments: demo-recording.mp4 (MP4, 55MB)
From: Diane Holt <diane.holt@ornaxhealth.com>

Date: 2026-11-10T17:23:00-05:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps (security discovery)

Thanks Ben — nice meeting. A few clarifying asks from our side before we can move to legal/procurement: 

1) SOC 2 Type II report — we need a copy of the most recent Type II report (redactions are acceptable). Can you confirm if the full report can be shared or only a summary? Our procurement team prefers a PDF.
2) Bridge letter/interim attestation — we will accept a temporary bridge letter while the full report is provided to our security team.
3) Trust portal access — please invite diane.holt@ornaxhealth.com and procurement@ornaxhealth.com with read-only access to artifacts (audit logs, encryption controls, vendor subprocessors list).
4) DSQ — please send your standard vendor security questionnaire (we will use that to validate controls).

Timeline: procurement needs a response by 11/22 to keep the vendor in the shortlist. If you can provide the bridge letter + portal invite by EOD 11/11 that would be ideal.

Also, a quick heads-up — we will anonymize any PII in the report if required. For the report, please indicate any sections that cannot be shared due to third-party auditor restrictions.

Regards,
Diane Holt
Head of Security & Compliance | Ornax Health
From: Mina Haddad <mina.haddad@redwoodinference.com>
To: Diane Holt <diane.holt@ornaxhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: 2026-11-11T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Quick recap + next steps (security discovery)

Hi Diane — thanks for the clear list. Quick status and what Ive attached/issued: 

What I attached/provisioned:
- Temporary_Bridge_Letter_Redwood_20261111.pdf (attached) — a one-page interim attestation that summarizes the SOC 2 Type II coverage and confirms there are no outstanding control exceptions. This is intended for procurement review.
- Trust portal invite sent to diane.holt@ornaxhealth.com and procurement@ornaxhealth.com (read-only). Invite link below. The portal contains our SOC 2 scope summary, control narratives, and a set of redacted artifacts. If you need deeper access we can elevate on request but want to follow least-privilege by default.

About the Type II report: the full auditor-signed report includes third-party auditor attachments that we cannot publish publicly; we typically provide either a redacted PDF or an auditor-approved summary. Jordan and I will coordinate with the audit team this week and aim to have a redacted PDF available by 11/17.

Attached: Temporary_Bridge_Letter_Redwood_20261111.pdf
Portal link (temporary invite): https://trust.redwoodinference.example/portal/ornax-access?invite=abc123
DSQ: Im attaching our standard Vendor Security Questionnaire template (we prefer the completed copy from you but can also accept the one we attach if you want us to pre-fill known answers).

If procurement needs anything in writing for the PO or SOW (SLA carve-outs, data residency clarifications) tell me and Ill escalate to Contracts.

Thanks — Ill follow up when the redacted Type II PDF clears legal review.

Best,
Mina Haddad
Security & Compliance Programs | Redwood Inference

Next from our side: we will aim to complete the DSQ by 11/18 and will let you know if any follow-up controls detail is required. If procurement needs the redacted PDF earlier we will request it, otherwise 11/17 sounds workable.

Appreciate the quick turnaround.
